fato_historico: 1985: Major General Muhammadu Buhari, Chairman of the Supreme Military Council of Nigeria, is ousted from power in a coup d'état led by Major General Ibrahim Babangida.
energia_do_dia: The universe invites you to release old structures that no longer serve your soul, much like the shifting tides of leadership and change in history. Today, you may feel an intuitive call to transform your inner landscape. It is a good time to embrace fluidity and let go of rigid expectations, allowing your compassionate spirit to find its natural path forward.
frase_do_dia: True power flows from a heart that knows when to gracefully change course.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of your hidden potential and spiritual clarity.
conselho: Trust your intuition and be open to shifting your perspective when necessary.
